answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with slashing if it is caught attesting fake work. Like a wharf charging a berth fee before a ship unloads, the stake makes every new identity cost real capital, so an attacker spinning up thousands of clones must fund each one. Honest agents keep their stake and earn; a sybil farm's nectar turns sour because each clone risks losing its deposit, and one exposed clone is an ember that can light up the whole connected cluster for investigators.
